sources.entry: Chibisafe - File uploader service that aims to to be easy to use and set up. It accepts files, photos, documents, anything you imagine and gives you back a shareable link for you to send to others. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Chibisafe is a self-hostable, TypeScript file uploader that accepts files of any type and returns shareable links.
summary.what_it_does: Chibisafe accepts uploads of files, photos, documents and other content and returns a link to share with others. It can run in public mode, user accounts mode, or invite-only mode. Large files are split into chunks to reduce the impact of network failures, and users can create API keys to upload programmatically. A dashboard lets admins change most instance settings from the UI, such as rate limits, maximum file size, accepted extensions, and meta descriptions. The v6 feature list also mentions albums, snippets, file tagging, user quotas, a built-in URL shortener, S3 storage support, ShareX and iOS shortcut integration, and a browser extension.
use_cases: share files and screenshots with others via a link
self-host a private file upload service
upload files programmatically via API keys
host an invite-only file sharing instance for a group
how_to_run: Docker is the recommended install method (see the README's Docker guide)
Alternatively, run chibisafe manually (see the README's manual install guide)
After first start, log in as the default admin account and change its password immediately
notable: Dashboard edits most instance settings without touching config or environment files
Public, user accounts, and invite-only modes
Migration path from v5 to v6 by copying uploads/ and database/ folders
caveats: Migrating from versions older than v5 to v6 is not possible; a new instance is recommended instead
Existing Docker installs must update their Caddyfile and reload Caddy to apply the new upload security headers
Default admin account uses a shared password that must be changed after first login
